mentions.name: Foreign Trivia
mentions.description: A wordle-style tiny daily trivia game where every question is in a different language, with tap-to-translate words as you play. Combines language-learning, pattern-matching, and trivia, with a new puzzle every day.
mentions.source_excerpt: For fun, this month I shipped Foreign Trivia - a wordle-style tiny daily trivia game where every question is in a different language, with tap-to-translate words as you play. It's part language-learning, part pattern-matching and part trivia. A new puzzle every day.
